# Events

Webhooks and Socket.IO deliver every event in the same envelope:

- `id` is unique per event; use it to drop duplicates.
- `seq` grows strictly per session and follows the order of the conversation, because it is assigned
  after the order buffer. Delivery is at least once, so a consumer has to be idempotent.
- `data` is always a data type of this page, never a raw WhatsApp Web object.

The first events are the ones whatsapp-web.js emits; from `session_status` on, the gateway makes them up.

## Events

### `qr`

WhatsApp Web shows a QR code to scan. A new one arrives every few seconds until the session is paired.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qr` | string | yes | The text to render as a QR code |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "qr",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "qr": "string"
  }
}
```

### `code`

The pairing code of a phone-number login is ready.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | yes |  |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "code",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "code": "string"
  }
}
```

### `authenticated`

Authentication succeeded; the session is about to become ready.

`data` is an empty object.

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "authenticated",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {}
}
```

### `auth_failure`

Restoring a saved session failed; the session needs a new QR code.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes |  |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "auth_failure",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```

  "event": "ready",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {}
}
```

  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "reason": "string"
  }
}
```

### `change_battery`

The battery of the linked phone changed. Deprecated by wwebjs.

`data` is a [BatteryInfoDto](#batteryinfodto).

### `message`

A message arrived. Messages the session sends itself arrive as message_create.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `message_create`

A message was created, including the ones the session itself sends.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `message_ack`

The delivery status of a message changed.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) | yes |  |
| `ack` | integer | yes | -1 error, 0 pending, 1 server, 2 device, 3 read, 4 played |

### `message_edit`

A message was edited.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) | yes |  |
| `newBody` | string | yes |  |
| `prevBody` | string | yes |  |

### `message_revoke_everyone`

A message was deleted for everyone in the chat.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) | yes | The message in its current state, without its original data |
| `revokedMessage` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) or null | no | The message before it was deleted; absent or null when it could not be captured |

### `message_revoke_me`

The session deleted a message for itself only.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `message_reaction`

A reaction was sent, received, changed or removed.

`data` is a [ReactionDto](#reactiondto).

### `message_ciphertext`

A message arrived that is not decrypted yet.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `message_ciphertext_failed`

A message could not be decrypted after WhatsApp retried.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `media_uploaded`

The media of a message the session sent finished uploading.

`data` is a [MessageDto](#messagedto).

### `unread_count`

The unread counter of a chat changed.

`data` is a [ChatDto](#chatdto).

### `chat_removed`

A chat was removed.

`data` is a [ChatDto](#chatdto).

### `chat_archived`

A chat was archived or unarchived.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chat` | [ChatDto](#chatdto) | yes |  |
| `currState` | boolean | yes |  |
| `prevState` | boolean | yes |  |

### `contact_changed`

A contact or a group participant changed their phone number.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) | yes |  |
| `oldId` | string | yes |  |
| `newId` | string | yes |  |
| `isContact` | boolean | yes |  |

### `group_join`

Someone joined a group by invite link or was added by an admin.

`data` is a [GroupNotificationDto](#groupnotificationdto).

### `group_leave`

Someone left a group or was removed by an admin.

`data` is a [GroupNotificationDto](#groupnotificationdto).

### `group_update`

The subject, description or picture of a group changed.

`data` is a [GroupNotificationDto](#groupnotificationdto).

### `group_admin_changed`

The session was promoted to admin of a group or demoted.

`data` is a [GroupNotificationDto](#groupnotificationdto).

### `group_membership_request`

Someone asked to join a group that approves its members.

`data` is a [GroupNotificationDto](#groupnotificationdto).

### `vote_update`

A poll option was selected or deselected.

`data` is a [PollVoteDto](#pollvotedto).

### `call`

A call came in.

`data` is a [CallDto](#calldto).

### `remote_session_saved`

A RemoteAuth session was saved to its store. The gateway does not use RemoteAuth, so this does not fire.

`data` is an empty object.

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "remote_session_saved",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {}
}
```

### `session_status`

The session moved to another status (created, starting, qr, pairing_code, authenticating, ready, disconnected, stopped, failed).

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `created`, `starting`, `qr`, `pairing_code`, `authenticating`, `ready`, `disconnected`, `stopped`, `failed` | yes |  |
| `previous` | `created`, `starting`, `qr`, `pairing_code`, `authenticating`, `ready`, `disconnected`, `stopped`, `failed` | yes |  |
| `reason` | string | no |  |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "session_status",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "status": "created",
    "previous": "created"
  }
}
```

### `message_batch`

A burst of messages written while the contact was offline was ordered and published. Answer once to this instead of to every message.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chatId` | string | yes |  |
| `messages` | [MessageDto](#messagedto)[] | yes | Ordered by sentAt |
| `firstSentAt` | ISO date | yes |  |
| `lastSentAt` | ISO date | yes |  |
| `count` | integer | yes | How many messages the batch holds |
| `origin` | [OriginDto](#origindto) | no | The first origin found among the messages |
| `reason` | `burst`, `reconcile` | yes |  |

### `message_sent`

A message queued by an asynchronous send was handed to WhatsApp.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes |  |
| `idempotencyKey` | string | no |  |
| `message` | [MessageDto](#messagedto) | no | Missing for a forward: WhatsApp answers nothing, and the forwarded copy arrives as its own `message_create` |

### `message_failed`

A queued message failed for good.

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobId` | string | yes |  |
| `idempotencyKey` | string | no |  |
| `error` | object | yes |  |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "message_failed",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "jobId": "string",
    "error": {
      "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      "message": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

### `session_error`

The session hit a failure before the manager reacted: Chromium crashed, WhatsApp calls time out, or sending degraded (SEND_HEALTH_DEGRADED) or paused (SEND_BREAKER_OPEN).

`data` holds:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | yes |  |
| `message` | string | yes |  |

```json
{
  "id": "evt_0f3c9a52-7d1e-4c0b-9a55-2f1d6e8b3a10",
  "event": "session_error",
  "sessionId": "support-line",
  "seq": 1,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-27T15:04:05.123Z",
  "data": {
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```

## Data types

The data types that events carry. The others (contacts, channels, labels…) are described with the operations that return them.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
